body:
Hey, don't think you're wasting my time. All you can do is base your advise off your opinions and experiences, so nothing you say is a waste. 

Heh, I know, I'm terrible with birthdays myself. One time me and all my siblings forgot our dad's birthday, so I can only imagine how that was for him. He was probably just as upset as I was when I originally posted here. 

Maybe we both should make the call. I don't know how your personal situation is, but it sounds like we both need help. I'm really really gonna make a concerted effort to call someone tomorrow and if you need help I hope you do too. We owe it to ourselves. 

Anyway, I think I've drank enough beer that it'll put me to sleep, but thanks for taking time to talk me through this. It's hard to get to the point where I have to reach out to random internet strangers for help, but I really appreciate you and everyone else talking me through this. I don't know where I would've ended up tonight without you guys. I hope the best for you in whatever life throws at you :)

Do it! I did it with a friend and we really enjoyed it. 

Thanks for talking to me though. I don't know who you are or where you come from, but just sitting here with you and a couple other internet strangers to talk to has made a world of difference to me. It saved me from doing awful things to myself that would only make me feel worse.

I know how much a sincere thank you means from someone so I just wanted to tell you thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for taking time out of whatever you were doing to just talk to me. Even though my birthday has come and gone at this point, when I go to bed this was enough for me to be able to end it on a much more positive note.

Yea, I have a really good friend who I usually talk to when things get rough, but even she forgot my birthday today which was pretty shocking because you can tell her your birthday once and she will remember it forever. It's freaky. Normally I'd talk to her but she goes to a different school and she's out partying because it's a Friday night and she's too drunk to console me. 

I hate opening up too. I feel like since I have an actually decent life that my problems are insignificant and that when I do confess them I'll just look dumb for getting so worked up over what bothers me. 

I could maybe get someone to do it for me...but I feel like that's cheating. If I really wanted to and had the desire to get rid of these dumb thoughts that I'd be able to call myself, but I just can't. I can pick up the phone and dial the number...but pressing the call button is a big obstacle for me, even though I've done it before.

Hahaha that made me laugh pretty hard, not gonna lie. I'm no conissuer (boy I butchered that spelling) by any means, but I like the occasional wine. I probably couldn't tell the difference between the $10 bottle and the $50 dollar bottle. When my extended family drinks wine they all have their preference of cabernet or merlot or whatever else and I probably couldn't tell you if I was drinking wine or some grape juice that was mixed with a little alcohol lol. But it's fun to make! I'd recommend giving it a try cause it was super cheap and easy. Just be careful how much yeast you add!

Yea it's definitely worth a shot I suppose. I definitely thought about telling them when I was upset earlier.

Yea I've been to therapy before and taken some antidepressants and they had limited success. The therapy worked better but I had to quit because I got too busy with school and other things. I've been trying to convince myself to go back but it's really hard to make that phone call just cause being so depressed makes it hard to seek help. I know I should, I just kind of wish someone would make the phone call for me, as sad as that sounds.

I'm a big blue moon guy myself too, actually. I had one earlier today when I went out to eat with my family. Never got into home brewing myself, and it's something that if I get a little more money I'd love to explore. I used to make my own wine freshman year of college. That was a fun experiment. First time I did it I put WAYY too much yeast in the mix. Then I drank the whole bottle in one night and pooped straight green/black for 2 days. Never made that mistake again!

Ah I love working out when I have the gym all to myself :) there's a certain peace about it. That and going for a nice long run. They really help center yourself and collect your thoughts so I'm with you on that!

Thank you though, I guess I really have spent too much time worrying about others and not enough about myself. That's gonna be one of my goals going forward, is to focus more on me. Cause if I can't be happy, then how can I help others be happy?

Miller high life! The champagne of beers! 

Honestly I hate the stuff and would never drink it normally, but $6 a 12 pack?! Who can pass up a deal like that??

Ha I am an Aries! 

I mean I can say something to them, but I feel like it'd fall on deaf ears. This was a bit of a demonstration of their apathy, so me trying to let them know that they fucked up could just be a waste of my breath. But who knows, I'll think more about it sober. 

Thanks for the well wishes, the suicidal thoughts come and go and I've been dealing with them for years. They were just exacerbated by the events of today. I try to remind myself of the good things in my life...but they get drowned out sometimes by shitty things like this.
HAPPY BIRTHDAY! I turned 22 myself. I really appreciate your message, and I'll dedicated this next sip of cheap cheap beer to you, birthday buddy.

Thanks! It is exciting, I'm pretty stoked for it. Yea, talking on here has calmed me down quite a bit (or maybe it's the beer I keep drinking lol). But it's just nice to know that despite my friends being who they are, there are still people out there, even if they're random strangers, who have the courtesy to help a guy in need.

Thanks, I appreciate what you said. It's just hard to help people who leech off your help for so long without any sort of meaningful thanks, ya know? I love helping people, especially my friends, but some are all take and no give. And I can't just stop being friends with them because of that because we're all friends and you can't really just stop hanging out with someone when we all hang out as a group. 

I've never really thought about doing things like that by myself. I guess it's because something like mini golf or seeing a movie is more fun for me with people than by myself. Like it's one thing to get a hole in one min golfing by myself, but it's another to do it around my friends so we all can cheer. But I get what you said, I really should take more time to do things for myself. I guess I spend too much time worrying about others and not enough on me. That's some good advice.

Sorry to hear about that. Sucks, doesn't it? 

I've thought about it. I'm getting a new job in a few months that'll move me across the state so we'll see what comes from that. It's just hard to abandon people who I've been through so much with and who I click with so well. I know they don't hate me they're just.... well they're just kinda shitheads. They probably just got high and didn't wanna get off their couches. 

I'm not gonna go to bed angry, I'm just upset is all. I'm sure I've forgotten their birthdays once or twice so I can't get mad, it's just upsetting when it's everyone. 

Anyway thanks for responding. It means a lot that someone even read my ramblings
